lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Mn2Si2 (reduced formula Mg6MnSi) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Mg, Mn, and Si centers in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements: Mg is surrounded by 10 Mg and 2 Mn or 10 Mg and 2 Si, while Mn and Si each have 4 Mg, 4 Mn, and 4 Si neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra.
